scope: Manual documentation reset requested by Raven; old automations remain disabled.

reviewCoverage.limit: Targeted reading of routes, prerequisites and representative sections, NOT complete line-by-line content or command-execution review of all186pages. No new runtime/full-acceptance claim.

findings.finding: Operator quickstart requires broad docs:check:generated and Go before an operator can progress. This is documentation-maintenance coupling, not the stated checkout-preparation outcome.
findings.action: FIXED: move generator/plugin-inventory checks into optional documentation-maintenance section; remove Go from basic checkout prerequisites; retain clear runtime limits.

findings.finding: Reference pages expose inventory-scale output: Helm8919lines/5101table rows, CLI11918lines/6812table rows. Large pages and duplicated source context impair lookup; volume alone does not demonstrate useful reference completeness.
findings.action: Reduce by reader-owned configuration/CLI family. Keep concise field/option/default/example/error/source; move repeated raw source/evidence into optional technical data. Do not discard actual supported settings.

findings.finding: Public generated-documentation-map.json is53018542bytes for186pages; its size is not necessary to render a page or explain a setting. Reference index links it directly.
findings.action: Separate compact public navigation/ownership summary from internal full sourceSurfaceMap. Inspect actual consumers before deleting or changing schema.

findings.finding: Developer handbook directs a new contributor to a fixed historical commit671234b; current status is dated September17 and install still explicitly stops for stored runtime configuration failure. These are disclosed limits, not proof of current supported operational success.
findings.action: Separate historical reproducibility recipe from present-day contributor route; validate chosen current baseline before changing commands. Keep install/recovery/runtime limits explicit, do not silently relabel as working.

findings.finding: Large operator pages: install1601lines, recovery1155lines; workflows index657lines includes full tutorials. Real task boundaries exist but index/procedure/reference are mixed.
findings.action: Keep index short; move complete first-project exercise to its own task page with links. Split install/recovery only at meaningful task boundaries, preserving command order and failure/cleanup information.

findings.finding: Saved checkout path refers to stale684822ae checkout while delivered reader and active source are8092fc00 in a different checkout.
findings.action: This reset uses actual8092fc00 source; preserve stale checkout unchanged. Correct manual task state path, no resumption of old workers.

generatorDecisions.readerValue: Read, search, navigate and download complete docs.
generatorDecisions.checks: Actual built reader, local links/assets and a few representative reader tasks; do not chain every acceptance campaign into export.

generatorDecisions.family: CLI options, owned configuration/schema fields, plugin metadata, SDK exports, error/event names
generatorDecisions.readerValue: Exact names/types/defaults and supported usage that should not be maintained twice.
generatorDecisions.implementation: Existing family owners/docs-generate.mjs, docs-sdk-reference.mjs and relevant catalogue generators
generatorDecisions.target: Generate from authoritative declarations; concise per-component pages with examples and stable source links. Third-party internals link upstream where meaningful; do not infer arbitrary runtime outputs.

generatorDecisions.family: Open issue/status views from one register
generatorDecisions.readerValue: One maintained issue list with honest limits, no repeated conflicting status copies.

generatorDecisions.family: Raw recursive inventories, sourceSurfaceMap, source excerpts and contract/recipe duplication
generatorDecisions.readerValue: Useful for targeted maintenance/debugging, not mandatory public page content or every reader build.
generatorDecisions.target: Publish only compact selected facts; inspect real consumers before schema/file removal.

generatorDecisions.family: Migration parity batches, assignments, extracted legacy blocks, old review status and deletion manifests
generatorDecisions.readerValue: Migration bookkeeping, not recurring publication requirement.
generatorDecisions.target: Keep necessary one-time history/parity evidence until legacy disposition is decided; remove execution from ordinary docs path in a separate bounded dependency change. No AP10 deletion claimed.

generatorDecisions.family: Whole-repository shell/Go/Node runtime output purpose analyzer and custody/hash-repin chains
generatorDecisions.readerValue: No demonstrated need to semantically prove every possible dynamic program output to render useful docs.
generatorDecisions.target: Stop expanding. Retain actual product/security checks, explicitly document unknown runtime boundaries, and assess shared consumers before deleting implementation.
